new_items.title: FDA Approves First Treatment for Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy Type 2I/R9
new_items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved the first medicine for treating limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2I/R9 (LGMD2I/R9), a rare inherited muscle disease, for adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 30 kg.

new_items.title: FDA Approves First New Hormone Therapy for Early-Stage Breast Cancer in More Than 20 Years
new_items.summary: The FDA today approved Wilserdly (giredestrant), used alone after surgery in adults with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative breast cancer — the most common subtype of the disease.
